description: Defines the class f1u_bearer_impl, which implements bearer handling, including PDU and SDU processing, timers, and metrics for a 5G NR user plane bearer in a radio system.

classes.name: f1u_bearer_impl
classes.description: Implementation of a 5G NR user plane bearer handling PDU/SDU processing, timers, and metrics.

methods.name: f1u_bearer_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the bearer with necessary parameters and dependencies.

methods.name: get_rx_pdu_handler
methods.description: Returns reference to the PDU handler interface.

methods.name: get_tx_sdu_handler
methods.description: Returns reference to the SDU handler interface.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the bearer, halting timers and processing.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Discards SDU with specified PDCP sequence number.

methods.name: get_ul_tnl_info
methods.description: Returns the uplink transport layer info.

methods.name: get_ul_teid
methods.description: Returns the UL TEID associated with this bearer.

methods.name: on_expired_dl_notif_timer
methods.description: Handles the expiration of the downlink notification timer to send discard blocks.
